truths.truth: Every prose site passing a quoted flag value is either watched by the check or recorded out-of-scope with a reason - nothing silently omitted
truths.evidence: TEXT_FLAGS (text-transport.mjs:98) watches 10 flags and its comment justifies excluding only enum/int flags (D-01). Two quoted-value flags in shipped prose are neither watched nor registered and carry no recorded reason: `--bracket-read "..."` (8 occurrences: workflows/context.md:159, execute.md:199, plan.md:99,268, verify-deep.md:8, references/plan-revision.md:16,32, seams.md:110) and `--payload "..."` (references/review-triggers.md:229). Their values are workflow-authored path lists, so the classification looks correct - but AC2 requires such sites to be listed out-of-scope with their reason, and the watched `--read` row IS registered for exactly this kind of value.
